summary: Focused frontend verification of the PlayerModal anti-popup defense completed. Default sandbox/allow policies, shield dismissal, popup counter, mobile layout, server switching, and telemetry persistence passed. Relaxed-mode native window.open could not be verified because the headless browser blocks script-initiated popups.
action_items: Manually verify relaxed-mode window.open with a real user gesture or non-headless browser; automated evaluate() popup opening is browser-blocked.
seed_data_creation: None; only existing homepage media was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anti-popup flow tested on desktop and mobile. Default policy, shield, counter, re-secure, server src switching, no mobile overflow, and voidstream:history telemetry passed. Relaxed native popup behavior remains environment-limited and needs manual/non-headless confirmation.
rca of the issue: The only incomplete assertion was window.open() while relaxed. The implementation restores the captured native function, but Playwright's headless page.evaluate context returns null for script-triggered popups even when popup passthrough is enabled; this is not sufficient evidence of an app defect.
